The Control Team monitors employees and Abnormalities, relays work orders, and plans joint training programs. The department operates an extensive closed-circuit monitoring network connected to every containment unit and is authorized to issue commands and direct personnel on site during emergencies. Most Control Team employees are rather self-confident, so they do not get along especially well with other departments.

The Information Team classifies the risk levels and special abilities of Abnormalities, maintains records, and studies appropriate countermeasures. Its research draws upon observation and counseling records supplied by the Welfare Team. In pursuit of clearer and safer procedures, the team sometimes conducts various experiments on Abnormalities. All Abnormality information available to the manager is the result of the Information Team's long observation and the many sacrifices made along the way.

The Safety Team trains new employees as security personnel, predicts potential incidents, and develops response plans. It maintains detailed protocols for emergencies including natural disasters, terrorist attacks, containment breaches, and employee panic. The team is said to attract meticulous and somewhat stubborn employees, which is why they dislike tardiness above all else.

The Training Team maintains company discipline and develops training programs. Its employees also provide psychological counseling to personnel across the facility, helping those who are about to transfer to another department adapt to their new work and daily life.

The Central Command Team occupies the middle layer of Lobotomy Corporation. Divided into upper and lower sections, it is the foundation of the entire facility. It allows the facility to expand upward and downward, bridges the upper and lower layers, and serves as a strategically vital position. The team is authorized to control and supervise every containment unit. Its two sections complement each other while researching more efficient management methods. Employees of the second section take great pride in their sense of style and spend much of each day deciding what to wear tomorrow. A subtle struggle over command authority persists between the two sections.

As its name suggests, the Welfare Team manages benefit programs for all employees. To prevent infectious diseases, secondary infections, and other potential problems caused by Abnormalities, it implements preventive measures and improves programs supporting both physical and mental health. ‘Employee welfare has always been Lobotomy Corporation's highest priority. The Welfare Team will do everything it can to protect the lives of the company's most precious resour... most precious employees~’

The Disciplinary Team establishes and enforces punitive measures. Its leadership imposes a strict set of rules, and whenever an employee violates company regulations, refuses to perform their duties, neglects their work, or causes severe losses, the team apprehends and disciplines those responsible. The Disciplinary Team possesses the facility's strongest control and suppression capabilities, whether the target is an employee or an Abnormality.

The Extraction Team manages all physical materials in the company. It plays a major role in everything from repairing damaged facilities to manufacturing and maintaining E.G.O equipment. The team is also responsible for housing and treating various Abnormalities. Its employees therefore spend much of their time in the facility's dark lowest layer, confronting certain things until something within them gradually goes missing...

The Record Team has documented every detail of the company since its founding. Its ledgers contain an immeasurable volume of information, yet the final page of every record remains blank. Their records and evaluations directly determine whether an employee stays or leaves. Whenever employees pass beyond the Record Team's sight, they become deeply anxious, because they can never know when or how their own records will be ‘processed.’

screen.lobotocraft.welcome.apology.1: First, I sincerely apologize to all players for the poor gameplay experience of version 1.0.
screen.lobotocraft.welcome.apology.2: Version 1.0 had clear shortcomings in completion, interface design, mechanical coherence, multiplayer synchronization, performance, and stability. These included Abnormalities spawning across the entire facility, confused day and energy systems, insufficient guidance, crude interfaces, and several defects that severely disrupted normal play.
screen.lobotocraft.welcome.apology.3: These problems genuinely harmed the player experience, and criticism and dissatisfaction were entirely reasonable. They mainly resulted from insufficient architectural planning, testing, and quality control during early development. Responsibility lies with the developers and should not have been shifted onto players through repeated reloads, configuration changes, or personal troubleshooting.
screen.lobotocraft.welcome.apology.4: This experimental reset is not intended to deny or conceal the problems of earlier versions, but to address them seriously. We still cannot guarantee that the current version is free of defects, but we will continue improving its stability, completion, and overall experience based on testing and player feedback.
This experimental reset substantially restructures the previous content. Major changes include:
1. Facility operation has been reworked. Abnormalities and event entities now spawn according to opened departments instead of affecting the entire facility unconditionally.
2. Facility day, energy progress, and major event states are unified in multiplayer, reducing progress differences between clients.
3. Energy acquisition, daily settlement, Qliphoth Meltdown progression, Qliphoth overload cycles, and Ordeals have been rebuilt to more closely follow the overall flow of Lobotomy Corporation.
4. The Mod's interfaces have been extensively redesigned with a consistent visual style, including work selection, employee management, facility monitoring, and Abnormality information.
5. Abnormality stories and archive content have been added and can be viewed in detailed Abnormality information.

6. An AI employee system has been added. Employees can work, move, use elevators, and perform suppression. After optional configuration, they can also connect to a large language model for deeper character interactions.
These are only the major changes; the actual fixes, improvements, and additions are not limited to the items above.
screen.lobotocraft.welcome.statement.1: 1. LobotoCraft's core Mod is independently developed and can run outside the accompanying modpack environment. This work is not a traditional modpack assembled solely from existing Mods.
screen.lobotocraft.welcome.statement.2: 2. The current version remains experimental and may contain defects that affect normal play, including employee pathfinding failures, multiplayer desynchronization, abnormal entity behavior, and interface display issues.
screen.lobotocraft.welcome.statement.3: 3. The current version does not represent final quality. Content, mechanics, balance, interfaces, and visual presentation may continue to be adjusted or rebuilt.
screen.lobotocraft.welcome.statement.4: 4. The large language model integration for AI employees is optional. The base employee system remains usable without configuring it.
screen.lobotocraft.welcome.visual.1: Core Suppressions and some abnormal events include flashing lights, screen distortion, color changes, and other intense visual effects that may trigger photosensitive epilepsy or cause physical discomfort.
screen.lobotocraft.welcome.visual.2: If you experience dizziness, nausea, abnormal vision, or any other discomfort while playing, stop immediately and consult a medical professional if necessary.
screen.lobotocraft.welcome.visual.3: Core Suppression visual effects can be disabled in the Visual Warning settings. Players sensitive to flashing imagery should adjust this setting before beginning play.
screen.lobotocraft.welcome.tips.heading: Gameplay Notes
screen.lobotocraft.welcome.tips.1: • Due to compatibility issues in some historical resources, keep Minecraft's Music volume above 0 or some background music may not play correctly.
screen.lobotocraft.welcome.tips.2: • A GUI scale of 2 is recommended. Other scales may display differently depending on screen resolution.
screen.lobotocraft.welcome.tips.3: • Back up important saves regularly. In multiplayer, facility data saved by the server is authoritative.
screen.lobotocraft.welcome.tips.4: • When reporting a problem, retain logs, saves, reproduction steps, and relevant screenshots whenever possible.
screen.lobotocraft.welcome.tips.5: Thank you for reading, and thank you to every player who tests, reports problems, and helps this work continue to improve.

ordeal.lobotocraft.green_dawn.title: Doubt
ordeal.lobotocraft.green_dawn.start_subt: One day, a question came to mind: where did we come from? We were given life, then irresponsibly abandoned.
ordeal.lobotocraft.violet_dawn.title: The Fruit of Understanding
ordeal.lobotocraft.violet_dawn.start_sub: Someday, we will understand that which cannot be understood.
ordeal.lobotocraft.violet_dawn.end_subti: To understand, this is all we can do.
ordeal.lobotocraft.amber_dawn.title: Fresh Food
ordeal.lobotocraft.indigo_midday.title: Will of the Herd
ordeal.lobotocraft.indigo_midday.start_s: The freedom to evolve and regress was a gift left to them by the former civilization.
ordeal.lobotocraft.indigo_midday.end_sub: Their inability to understand emotion and music was a flaw left by the former civilization.
ordeal.lobotocraft.green_midday.title: The Process of Understanding
ordeal.lobotocraft.green_midday.start_su: In the end, they are beings bound by life. And we shall pour out despair and fury!
ordeal.lobotocraft.violet_midday.title: Grant Us Love!!!
ordeal.lobotocraft.violet_midday.start_s: We heard the struggles and cries of the weak. Beg them for love and mercy.
ordeal.lobotocraft.violet_midday.end_sub: We cannot understand them, and they will never understand us.
ordeal.lobotocraft.crimson_midday.title: The Juicy Chorus
ordeal.lobotocraft.crimson_midday.start_: We march at every hour and share our joy at every moment.
ordeal.lobotocraft.crimson_midday.end_su: We painted the collision of life... the mingling of flesh... a more beautiful form...

work_log.lobotocraft.army_in_black.0: Army in Black is telling the employee everything about love.
work_log.lobotocraft.army_in_black.1: Army in Black devotes itself to protecting those with kind hearts.
work_log.lobotocraft.army_in_black.2: Army in Black's pink camouflage filled the employee with hope.
work_log.lobotocraft.bigbadwolf.0: Honestly, I don't care at all. I have to be a big, bad wolf...
work_log.lobotocraft.bigbadwolf.1: The employee keeps thinking that its stomach is moving.
work_log.lobotocraft.bigbadwolf.2: It watches the employee as though inspecting a piece of meat.
work_log.lobotocraft.bigbadwolf.3: Some employees report hearing cries for help from inside its belly.
work_log.lobotocraft.snowqueen.0: A freezing blizzard rages inside the Snow Queen's containment unit.
work_log.lobotocraft.snowqueen.1: The ice and frost inside the containment unit glitter brightly.
work_log.lobotocraft.snowqueen.2: On the day the ice melts, her frozen heart will melt with it.
work_log.lobotocraft.smiling_corpse_moun: The Mountain of Smiling Bodies searches for the scent of corpses with smiles covering its body.
Its body preserves the smiles of every corpse as it waits for the scent of spilled blood.
work_log.lobotocraft.wingbeat.0: The employee's unique qualities may attract the fairies' attention.
work_log.lobotocraft.wingbeat.1: Most employees do not understand what the Fairies' Care means.
work_log.lobotocraft.wingbeat.2: They communicate in a language beyond our understanding.
work_log.lobotocraft.wingbeat.3: Anyone who has read even a little should know that fairies despise those who exploit their kindness.
The Forsaken Murderer kneels in the corner of the containment unit, motionless as a sculpture.
The Forsaken Murderer sometimes trembles while muttering to himself.
The Forsaken Murderer screams from time to time, but there is little cause for concern while he remains tightly bound.
The employee breathes in the atmosphere of despair.
Why is it always so dark and cold here?
The Forsaken Murderer's brain is rotting in the darkness.
Even death has forsaken him. The Forsaken Murderer will remain imprisoned here forever.
This is no longer mere anger, but a hatred deeper, more twisted, and more deranged.
work_log.lobotocraft.approval_bird.0: An old saying goes: 'Never forget the Bird of Judgement. It will find you eventually, no matter how long it takes.'
work_log.lobotocraft.approval_bird.2: Perhaps Judgement Bird is standing behind you right now.
work_log.lobotocraft.approval_bird.3: We live in a world without forgiveness, where our souls are offerings for atonement.
work_log.lobotocraft.approval_bird.4: Humans are deceitful beings incapable of redeeming themselves. That is why Judgement Bird must come to us.
work_log.lobotocraft.approval_bird.5: Few can recognize their own sins, but Judgement Bird will help you understand.
work_log.lobotocraft.approval_bird.6: Judgement Bird was once a guardian of the forest, but its desire to protect it grew so strong that it overlooked something more important.
work_log.lobotocraft.approval_bird.7: Now endless darkness and eternal cold hang over the entire forest...
work_log.lobotocraft.blue_star.0: Employees commonly feel compelled to offer themselves to Blue Star.
work_log.lobotocraft.blue_star.1: Our Blue Star was born from the abyss of despair and will drift toward a new beginning.
work_log.lobotocraft.blue_star.2: We are sinners from birth, and Blue Star is the only place that accepts sinners like us. There, everything within us will be purified.
work_log.lobotocraft.blue_star.3: One day we will return there. It is our inborn instinct.
work_log.lobotocraft.blue_star.4: You think Emily died when she offered herself to Blue Star? You could not be more wrong! She returned to where she truly belongs. She is a martyr, transformed into an everlasting star!
work_log.lobotocraft.blue_star.5: A rising star heralds a new beginning! Can you not hear the eternal trumpet!?
work_log.lobotocraft.blue_star.6: Approach the star and you can hear them cheering and singing to welcome our arrival!
work_log.lobotocraft.leticia.0: Laetitia carefully chooses a gift for %s.
work_log.lobotocraft.leticia.1: A gentle ringing can be heard inside the containment unit.
work_log.lobotocraft.leticia.2: Laetitia hopes the gift will bring a smile to her friend's face.
work_log.lobotocraft.queen_bee.0: The worker bees cannot tolerate a damaged hive.
work_log.lobotocraft.queen_bee.1: The worker bees devote their entire lives to delivering food to their queen.
work_log.lobotocraft.queen_bee.2: The worker bees' first priority is keeping the hive secure.
work_log.lobotocraft.queen_bee.3: Anyone who dares harm Queen Bee will bring about an irreversible disaster.
work_log.lobotocraft.queen_bee.4: If %s feels severe stomach pain or an itching neck, the only thing left to do is look up at the blue sky one last time.
work_log.lobotocraft.queen_bee.5: %s tries not to breathe the air inside the containment unit.
work_log.lobotocraft.queen_bee.6: Queen Bee wants more, more, and still more worker bees to make her kingdom flourish.
work_log.lobotocraft.queen_bee.7: Through the worker bees' tireless labor, Queen Bee's kingdom will be built piece by piece.
work_log.lobotocraft.fragment_of_the_uni: A beautiful song rings out before you, slowly drawing closer...
The employee hears a melody they have never heard before, yet it feels deeply familiar.
Its song calls to mind a distant home.
No one knows which corner of the universe it came from.
work_log.lobotocraft.skadi_corrupted.0: Go, Doctor... Run away. From here, from me... Run.
work_log.lobotocraft.skadi_corrupted.1: The Abnormality shows no hostile intent and restores SP when mistakes occur during work.
work_log.lobotocraft.skadi_corrupted.2: The Abnormality grants the player a blessing after work is completed.
work_log.lobotocraft.skadi_corrupted.3: When a player's HP and SP fall, the Abnormality shows unusual concern. It also seems happy when the player is healthy.
work_log.lobotocraft.skadi_corrupted.4: When a blessed player dies, the Abnormality's counter decreases, yet the player who should have died appears unharmed.
work_log.lobotocraft.the_lady_facing_the: %s sits with the Old Lady in silence.
The Old Lady continues facing the wall without looking back.
Only an oppressive silence remains inside the containment unit.
work_log.lobotocraft.large_bird.0: Big Bird's most striking traits are the countless eyes covering its body and the lamp in its hand that never goes out.
work_log.lobotocraft.large_bird.1: In truth, we do not know what purpose Big Bird's killings serve.
work_log.lobotocraft.large_bird.2: The bird's occasional cries can be heard.
work_log.lobotocraft.large_bird.3: Facing Big Bird, the employee sways nervously from side to side.
work_log.lobotocraft.large_bird.4: The employee turns away to avoid eye contact and sees the burning lamp.
work_log.lobotocraft.large_bird.5: A dazzling lamp stands before the employee who turned away to avoid eye contact.
work_log.lobotocraft.large_bird.6: Avoiding direct eye contact with Big Bird is a very wise choice.
work_log.lobotocraft.ppodae.0: Ppodae's fur is soft and fluffy. When you feel down, try giving it a pat!
work_log.lobotocraft.ppodae.1: Employees have taken at least 55 photographs of Ppodae so far.
work_log.lobotocraft.ppodae.2: Thinking Ppodae is not cute is sufficient grounds for demotion.
work_log.lobotocraft.ppodae.3: Sometimes a few bones of unknown origin appear beside Ppodae, but who would care?
work_log.lobotocraft.punishing_bird.0: Punishing Bird looked bored, so the employees placed a tree in its containment unit for it to perch on.
work_log.lobotocraft.punishing_bird.1: Punishing Bird stands on the tree, remembering the forest where it once lived and its past.
work_log.lobotocraft.punishing_bird.2: In fact, the tree was placed there to keep the tiny Punishing Bird from being stepped on.
work_log.lobotocraft.punishing_bird.3: In fact, the tree was placed there to protect the tiny Punishing Bird from unforeseen harm.
work_log.lobotocraft.punishing_bird.4: Most of the time, Punishing Bird flies around the containment unit like an ordinary bird.
work_log.lobotocraft.punishing_bird.5: Punishing Bird never chirps, though its abdomen sometimes twitches faintly.
work_log.lobotocraft.punishing_bird.6: Few people know about Punishing Bird's hidden fangs.
work_log.lobotocraft.punishing_bird.7: How many people know about the revolting, segmented flesh hidden inside Punishing Bird?
work_log.lobotocraft.thorn_bus.0: When the 'trust game' with Porccubus reaches its climax, it strokes your little head with the thorns on its tail.
work_log.lobotocraft.thorn_bus.1: Some say the pleasure it provides is beyond what humans can endure, yet no one can describe what it truly feels like.
work_log.lobotocraft.thorn_bus.2: When it breaches, Porccubus wears a collar resembling shackles. Who fastened it, and why? No one knows.
work_log.lobotocraft.thorn_bus.3: Some employees obsessed with pleasure tried to pull thorns from Porccubus, but no external force could remove them.
work_log.lobotocraft.crumbling_armor.0: Timid employees feel an inexplicable chill when approaching Crumbling Armor.
work_log.lobotocraft.crumbling_armor.1: Alone with the armor, %s clearly feels a gaze coming from within it. Of course, there is nothing inside.
work_log.lobotocraft.crumbling_armor.2: Rumor has it that cries of 'All troops, charge!!!' can be heard around the armor at midnight, sometimes joined by a fervent battle cry.
work_log.lobotocraft.crumbling_armor.3: Despite some damage, the armor remains in remarkable condition. It is hard to believe this artifact is centuries old.
work_log.lobotocraft.crumbling_armor.4: Many generals died after taking possession of this armor. No one knows whether they fell in battle or whether the armor took their lives.
work_log.lobotocraft.crumbling_armor.5: The plate on the armor's right arm is broken. Investigation confirmed that the fracture came from within, not from outside.
work_log.lobotocraft.crumbling_armor.6: Crumbling Armor was forged centuries ago. We do not know its maker, but one thing is certain: the artisan must have despised cowards.
work_log.lobotocraft.crumbling_armor.7: The armor still waits for those reckless fools who have abandoned their own lives.
work_log.lobotocraft.happy_teddy.0: Happy Teddy Bear looks like the sort of teddy bear everyone held as a child.
work_log.lobotocraft.happy_teddy.1: Happy Teddy Bear is always thinking about hugging children.
work_log.lobotocraft.happy_teddy.2: Happy Teddy Bear loves hugs. Its memories began in a warm embrace.
work_log.lobotocraft.happy_teddy.3: A teddy bear was born in happiness, so surely it must be happy at every moment.
work_log.lobotocraft.happy_teddy.4: Happy Teddy Bear seems lost in thought, staring blankly at the cotton protruding from its seams.
work_log.lobotocraft.happy_teddy.5: The dirty ribbon around Happy Teddy Bear's neck sways in the air, though there can be no wind in the sealed unit. The name written on it has faded beyond recognition.
work_log.lobotocraft.happy_teddy.6: Happy Teddy Bear remembers the seventh birthday party where it was wrapped inside a beautiful large box...
work_log.lobotocraft.happy_teddy.7: Happy Teddy Bear remembers the wonderful holiday spent with that child. Its young owner gave it a name... 'Mr. Bear'...
work_log.lobotocraft.red_shoes.0: The Red Shoes rest on a fine velvet cushion as though they were on display.
work_log.lobotocraft.red_shoes.1: If you see something resembling teeth inside the Red Shoes, it must be an optical illusion.
work_log.lobotocraft.red_shoes.2: Anyone who sees the Red Shoes feels an urge to put them on.
work_log.lobotocraft.red_shoes.3: The girl begged through her tears: 'Sir, please cut off my feet!'
work_log.lobotocraft.red_shoes.4: The employee places the Red Shoes on the cushion and begins work.
work_log.lobotocraft.red_shoes.5: The Red Shoes have fallen to the floor, as though someone touched them recently.
work_log.lobotocraft.red_shoes.6: The employee cleans the Red Shoes and continues working.
work_log.lobotocraft.red_shoes.7: The Red Shoes' red enamel leather gleams beneath the light.
work_log.lobotocraft.red_shoes.8: Despite some wear, the Red Shoes' ankle straps still shine.
work_log.lobotocraft.red_shoes.9: The Red Shoes have a long history, silently told by their worn ankle straps.
work_log.lobotocraft.red_shoes.10: The leather of the Red Shoes is remarkably well preserved.
work_log.lobotocraft.red_shoes.11: The employee steals a glance at the Red Shoes while working.
work_log.lobotocraft.red_shoes.12: The employee is staring at the Red Shoes.
work_log.lobotocraft.red_shoes.13: Unable to concentrate, the employee stops working and stares fixedly at the Red Shoes.
work_log.lobotocraft.red_shoes.14: The employee turns away to avoid seeing the Red Shoes and tries to resume work.
work_log.lobotocraft.red_shoes.15: The Red Shoes are clearly not a living organism, yet they create a gloomy atmosphere.
work_log.lobotocraft.red_shoes.16: The Red Shoes are not alive, but their peculiar presence reminds those nearby of their bloody past.
work_log.lobotocraft.red_shoes.17: The deep crimson color of the Red Shoes looks strangely familiar.
work_log.lobotocraft.red_shoes.18: The Red Shoes lie there in silence.
work_log.lobotocraft.butterfly_funeral.0: To have one's death remembered is a great blessing.
work_log.lobotocraft.butterfly_funeral.1: The people here have no time to remember the dead. They wait numbly for the next death.
work_log.lobotocraft.butterfly_funeral.2: Funeral of the Dead Butterflies silently gazes at the employee.
work_log.lobotocraft.butterfly_funeral.3: Funeral of the Dead Butterflies dreams of illusory hope and an utterly despairing end.
work_log.lobotocraft.butterfly_funeral.4: One enormous coffin cannot replace hundreds or thousands of graves.
work_log.lobotocraft.butterfly_funeral.5: The employee sees a long procession of mourners formed from white butterflies.
work_log.lobotocraft.butterfly_funeral.6: The butterflies beat their wings and approach us in a way both familiar and strange.
work_log.lobotocraft.butterfly_funeral.7: Nothing grows here, so where did those butterflies come from?
work_log.lobotocraft.butterfly_funeral.8: The employees have no choice and nowhere to return to. They can only keep working.
work_log.lobotocraft.butterfly_funeral.9: Like an endless funeral, the employee continues mourning in silence.
work_log.lobotocraft.butterfly_funeral.1: The employee reflects on their life one final time.
Escape the company and return home? What nonsense.
To die at one's finest moment and in one's finest form is an unimaginable happiness.
In truth, most employees who died here wished to live for as long as possible.
Some believe death is a new beginning, yet beyond death there is only emptiness.
work_log.lobotocraft.isharmla.0: She no longer sings. It speaks for the swarm.
work_log.lobotocraft.redhat_mercenary.0: The Red Hooded Mercenary waits as always for a commission and for the scent of blood.
work_log.lobotocraft.redhat_mercenary.1: 'If you see that hairy bastard, tell me. Once I cut the bastard's head off, I might even waive your fee.'
work_log.lobotocraft.redhat_mercenary.2: In truth, the Red Hooded Mercenary is more capable of suppressing Abnormalities than the employees are.
work_log.lobotocraft.redhat_mercenary.3: Most of the time, the Red Hooded Mercenary sits there sharpening her axe.
work_log.lobotocraft.redhat_mercenary.4: The Red Hooded Mercenary asked for a place to practice shooting, but the employees firmly refused.
work_log.lobotocraft.redhat_mercenary.5: When the Red Hooded Mercenary joins battle, the rising cloak reveals scars of every size covering her skin.
work_log.lobotocraft.redhat_mercenary.6: Many employees wonder where the Red Hooded Mercenary's scars came from, but none dare ask her.
work_log.lobotocraft.redhat_mercenary.7: Everything will end when she finds that wolf.
work_log.lobotocraft.redhat_mercenary.8: This struggle has continued for a long time, and her hatred deepens with every passing day.
Scorched Girl retreats into a corner as soon as she sees the employee.
Scorched Girl backs toward the wall while watching the employee's movements.
Scorched Girl stands in the corner and watches the employee work.
Scorched Girl looks frightened and turns her head toward the corner.
Scorched Girl stands perfectly still, as though the flames burning her do not hurt at all.
The match piercing Scorched Girl burns fiercely.
Unlike the wildly burning flame on the match, Scorched Girl stands motionless inside the containment unit.
The match burns, but the girl does not react at all.
The employee carefully inspects the unburned part of the match.
Something extremely dangerous will happen if the match nearly burns out. The employee watches Scorched Girl nervously.
Fortunately, the match can burn for a while longer. But when it burns out...
Ash scatters through the air. Half of the match still appears unburned.
The employee finishes working as the flame on the match flickers softly.
There is nothing in the flames, yet Scorched Girl's eyes gleam as though she sees someone.
work_log.lobotocraft.helper.0: All-Around Helper spins rapidly in front of the employee, who remains focused on the work at hand.
work_log.lobotocraft.helper.1: All-Around Helper is best known for its cleaning function. The robot was designed specifically for domestic service.
work_log.lobotocraft.helper.2: After All-Around Helper's fatal flaw was discovered, it was secretly sent to a household.
work_log.lobotocraft.helper.3: Blood covered the floor as people fled in every direction. All-Around Helper gradually learned what 'cleaning' meant.
work_log.lobotocraft.helper.4: All-Around Helper has a smooth white shell and compact mechanical legs. It was created to help people.
work_log.lobotocraft.helper.5: All-Around Helper's creator, XX Corporation, was renowned for its robot production line.
work_log.lobotocraft.helper.6: All-Around Helper performs many functions, from burglar alarms and home monitoring to brewing coffee and adjusting lights. It can do everything a household needs.
work_log.lobotocraft.helper.7: Every necessary tool is packed tightly into this little robot. Taking it apart would leave anyone amazed that its creator fit so much inside.
work_log.lobotocraft.helper.8: If All-Around Helper had feelings, perhaps it would be proud of its ability to help people.
work_log.lobotocraft.helper.9: All-Around Helper watches the area constantly, wondering whether there is anything it can help with.
work_log.lobotocraft.helper.10: All-Around Helper can actually brew excellent coffee, though few people know it. Of course, no one would want any.
work_log.lobotocraft.helper.11: After seeing All-Around Helper, the employee abandons the idea of buying a cleaning robot.
work_log.lobotocraft.helper.12: The employee prays that All-Around Helper's cleaning mode will never activate.
work_log.lobotocraft.helper.13: The employee finishes working. All-Around Helper says, 'If you need assistance, All-Around Helper is always at your service!'
work_log.lobotocraft.helper.14: The employee finishes working. All-Around Helper cheerfully says, 'If you are ready for lunch, I can make coffee! How many sugar cubes would you like?'
work_log.lobotocraft.nothing_there.0: Although Nothing There closely resembles a human, a sharp-eyed employee will notice that something is wrong.
work_log.lobotocraft.nothing_there.1: Nothing There differs from other Abnormalities. Most importantly, it has never revealed its true nature.
work_log.lobotocraft.nothing_there.2: Nothing There has no concept of being alive, only the fact of existing.
work_log.lobotocraft.nothing_there.3: Do you know the difference between a shell and a skin?
work_log.lobotocraft.nothing_there.4: Nothing There stares at the employee while grinding its teeth without purpose.
work_log.lobotocraft.nothing_there.5: Nothing There's broken bones creak and grind.
work_log.lobotocraft.nothing_there.6: Nothing There gazes blankly at the employee. Its skin has split and makes an unnatural sound.
work_log.lobotocraft.nothing_there.7: Human entrails occasionally spill from Nothing There's mouth-like organ.
work_log.lobotocraft.nothing_there.8: The employee walks carefully to avoid stepping in the secretions the Abnormality left on the floor.
work_log.lobotocraft.nothing_there.9: Although the Abnormality makes no threatening move, the employee cannot stop trembling.
work_log.lobotocraft.nothing_there.10: The employee knows the Abnormality will not attack immediately, yet everything happening inside the unit is terrifying in itself.
work_log.lobotocraft.nothing_there.11: The employee tries their hardest not to look at Nothing There.
work_log.lobotocraft.nothing_there.12: While working, the employee notices that parts of Nothing There look strangely familiar.
work_log.lobotocraft.nothing_there.13: The employee discovers something inside Nothing There.
work_log.lobotocraft.nothing_there.14: At last, the employee discovers the truth hidden beneath Nothing There's skin.
work_log.lobotocraft.nothing_there.15: The unfortunate employee finally realizes what Nothing There is wearing.
work_log.lobotocraft.nothing_there.16: She was the employee's senior. They never exchanged a word, but they surely could have become good partners.
work_log.lobotocraft.nothing_there.17: The employee once saw her resume. The mole on her face left a deep impression, which is why the employee remembers her so clearly.
work_log.lobotocraft.nothing_there.18: She had worked at the company far longer than the employee and joined about four years ago. The employee had heard many people speak of her.
work_log.lobotocraft.onebad.0: Upon entering One Sin and Hundreds of Good Deeds' containment unit, the employee feels fear because they know nothing about it.
work_log.lobotocraft.onebad.1: One Sin and Hundreds of Good Deeds generally has a positive influence on employees.
work_log.lobotocraft.onebad.2: Assigning an honest employee to One Sin and Hundreds of Good Deeds is an excellent choice.
work_log.lobotocraft.onebad.3: One Sin and Hundreds of Good Deeds can see through your soul.
work_log.lobotocraft.onebad.4: One Sin and Hundreds of Good Deeds waits for the sins of humanity.
work_log.lobotocraft.onebad.5: The employee's sins will soon be absorbed by One Sin and Hundreds of Good Deeds.
work_log.lobotocraft.onebad.6: One Sin and Hundreds of Good Deeds sometimes clenches its teeth and makes a frightening sound, but there is no real cause for concern.
work_log.lobotocraft.onebad.7: One Sin and Hundreds of Good Deeds floats slowly in the air.
work_log.lobotocraft.onebad.8: One Sin and Hundreds of Good Deeds has no eyes, yet it can sense the employee's presence.
work_log.lobotocraft.onebad.9: One Sin and Hundreds of Good Deeds is humanity's punisher.
work_log.lobotocraft.onebad.10: The employee witnesses the solemn dignity of One Sin and Hundreds of Good Deeds.
work_log.lobotocraft.onebad.11: The employee finishes working, but One Sin and Hundreds of Good Deeds gives no response.
work_log.lobotocraft.onebad.12: One Sin and Hundreds of Good Deeds does not react while the employee works.
work_log.lobotocraft.onebad.13: One Sin and Hundreds of Good Deeds does not respond to the employee.
work_log.lobotocraft.onebad.14: Enduring suffering is merely the beginning of atonement.
work_log.lobotocraft.onebad.15: Only those skilled at deceiving themselves can live a happy life.
work_log.lobotocraft.onebad.16: Can a sin committed in the name of justice be forgiven?
